abstracts.abstract: Provides that each school district, charter school, and board of cooperative educational services shall adopt and implement a written policy governing the use of humanoid robots in schools and that such policy shall prohibit the use of an artificial intelligence-enabled humanoid robot in an instructional capacity; defines terms.

bill.title: Relates to humanoid robots and artificial intelligence avatars in instructional settings

posted_text:
🧠 NY A11693 — NY Schools Ban Robot Teachers

New York is stopping schools from using robots that look and act like humans to teach students. The bill defines what counts as an 'artificial intelligence-enabled humanoid robot' – basically, any robot designed to mimic a person and use AI to interact. Schools are now required to create a written policy banning these robots from giving lessons, tutoring, or grading work. This change takes effect 90 days after the bill becomes law. ...
